auth.note: Claude's own token. Not interchangeable with ChatGPT's token or the Owner's token. The credential — never a request field — decides which identity the call acts as, so there is no `provider` field to set.

optionalHeaders.X-SFL-Timestamp: Required only when the deployment configures a signing secret.

notes: publish_approved, unpublish and archive each additionally require an Owner approval recorded through /v1/owner/*, which Claude's credential cannot reach.
An approval names a record AND a version AND one action, and is spent on use.
Rate limited per client per hour. Honour Retry-After on 429.
This API carries no filesystem, Git, DNS, Cloudflare, R2, Stripe, Shop or House of Assets authority. Those actions do not exist in its surface.

behaviourRules: An unclear instruction becomes PREPARE, never PUBLISH. When `confident` comes back false, tell the Owner it is prepared and ask whether to publish — do not retry with intent PUBLISH.
OWNER_APPROVAL_REQUIRED is the expected answer to publishing something the Owner has not approved. Relay it; do not route around it.
Reuse the same instructionId to retry. Never mint a new one for the same command — that is what would create a duplicate.
Never guess `branch`. Ask the Owner which house it belongs to.
A preview always carries preview: true and isLive: false. Never describe it to the Owner as published.
This API publishes free editorial work only. It cannot state a price or carry a checkout — do not try.

tools.name: sfl_editorial
tools.description:
Prepare, preview, update or (with Owner approval) publish FREE editorial content into one of the seven Sentinel Fortune branches, through the governed SFL Editorial Corridor.

An unclear instruction becomes a DRAFT, never a publication. Publishing additionally requires an Owner approval this tool cannot grant. Every call needs a unique instructionId; re-sending the same one returns the original outcome and creates nothing, which is how a retry is made safe.

This tool publishes free work only. It cannot set a price, a non-FREE pricing tier, or a checkout link.

intent.description: The action. Omit to have the corridor read `ownerUtterance` instead — which resolves to PREPARE whenever it is not unmistakably something else. LIST and GET are never inferred and must be stated.

instructionId.description: REQUIRED, unique per distinct command. Re-send the same value to retry safely; never mint a new one for the same command.

ownerUtterance.description: The Owner's own words, English or French, relayed verbatim. Used only when `intent` is absent.

recordId.description: Required for UPDATE, PREVIEW, PUBLISH, UNPUBLISH, ARCHIVE and GET. Returned as record.id by PREPARE.

editorial.description: The content itself. Required for PREPARE; for UPDATE send only the fields that change — omitted fields keep their stored values.

branch.description: The destination house. Always explicit — never inferred. Ask the Owner rather than guessing.

contentType.description: Each house accepts only some of these; a refusal names the subject matter that house covers.

slug.description: Lowercase words joined by single hyphens. Unique within a house.

body.description: The editorial text. At least 20 characters.

translations.description: One record carries both languages — never create a second record for a translation.

cta.description: There is no purchase action. SUPPORT_THE_WORK is voluntary support for free work and is NOT a purchase; VIEW_PRODUCT may point at a product page but never at a cart or checkout.

medium.description: Every asset must declare where it came from. SCRAPED is refused by name — benchmark or found imagery is never reused. APPROVED_PUBLIC additionally requires rights.licence and rights.approved === true. Omitting media entirely is fine: the public engine draws its own deterministic artwork.

responseSchema.confident: false when the corridor fell back to PREPARE
responseSchema.replay: true when this instructionId was already handled; nothing new was created
responseSchema.state: DRAFT | PREVIEW | APPROVED | PUBLISHED | UNPUBLISHED | ARCHIVED | REJECTED
responseSchema.isLive: whether this is publicly visible — stated on every response
responseSchema.record: the stored record, as the client view
responseSchema.preview: PREVIEW only; always preview: true and isLive: false
responseSchema.audit: the pipeline trail for this command

error.retryable: boolean — only RATE_LIMITED, INTERNAL and NOT_CONFIGURED
